title: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in…
description: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 2.11.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'comment' parameter. This flaw arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts. Exploitation requires the plugin's CDN feature to be enabled, as the vulnerable output-buffer filter is only active in that mode.
